scope: Approved synthetic cow fixture mobile list thumbnail only. Local analysis; no browser/network writes; no image artifacts created.
conclusion: The mobile thumbnail is consistent with the centered cover crop of the downloaded source, with a small capture-level luminance difference. No evidence of a material uniform dim layer. The original photo itself has dark foreground areas. Exact equivalence and a very small effect cannot be established from this JPEG capture.
materiality_for_this_check: A uniform attenuation of at least 5% in encoded RGB/luma would be material for this comparison. This is an engineering comparison threshold, not a perceptual universal or statistical confidence interval.

geometry.rounded_corner_handling: Principal 72x72 ROI is inset at least 12 CSS px. Sensitivity ROIs use 6px and 18px insets; even 6px excludes the 12px-radius curved boundary.
geometry.capture_mapping: Direct CSS-coordinate model plus a plausible 502x757 physical raster -> 402x606 capture model, with thumbnail at (46,310) physical pixels and 120x120 physical size. Physical capture dimensions are inferred from measured CSS extents and DPR; pipeline resampling is not independently established.

methodology.luma: 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B on decoded 8-bit channels (0..255); encoded luma proxy, not linear-light luminance.
methodology.source_handling: Decode supplied original JPEG without edits; center-cover crop and controlled resize in memory only. No source image or screenshot written/copied/published.
methodology.comparisons: Pixel correspondence, mean ratio, zero-intercept gain, affine gain/offset, correlation, MAE/RMSE; inset and resampler sensitivity.
methodology.color: Neither input includes an ICC profile; use decoded RGB with ordinary sRGB-like interpretation. Any browser/display/capture color transform is unknown.
methodology.visual_check: Original source and authorized mobile capture inspected. Cow/landscape foreground is already dark in source; sky remains bright in thumbnail.
methodology.computed_style_evidence: Recorded thumbnail/ancestor opacity=1, filter=none, blend mode=normal; background consists of URL layers with no gradient. Style evidence alone does not prove pixels.

sensitivity.note: These ranges express chosen geometric/resampling sensitivity; not statistical uncertainty bounds.

interpretation.mean_difference: Principal model: screenshot mean 121.01474 vs source-model 123.44698, about 2.0% lower.
interpretation.gain_fit: Best multiplicative gain 0.98677 (about 1.3% lower). Affine slope 1.00336 and offset -2.84706 indicate a small approximately constant decoded-channel difference rather than strong uniform attenuation.
interpretation.fit_quality: Luma correlation 0.99857. A 5% attenuation model has greater error than no attenuation; 10% and 20% attenuation are clearly inconsistent.
caveats: Compressed screenshot and unknown browser/capture filtering prevent exact reproduction.
Fractional CSS placement, DPR normalization, JPEG decoding/compression, and color handling can cause small differences.
A tiny dimming effect cannot be distinguished conclusively from capture artifacts.
The result applies to this approved mobile list fixture, not other photos, desktop/tablet, or hero image until separately measured.
